interpretation: The two-view estimator found parallax and low residuals, but almost all accepted features lie on the distant textured bookshelf. The foreground box and tabletop supplied almost no accepted points. The resulting cloud is not yet convincing scene-depth reconstruction.
next_decision: Require a meaningful fraction of triangulated features in both image halves; repeat with textured foreground at a distinct depth, then register a third view and test consistency.
limits: No verified metric scale, independent 3D ground truth, multi-view bundle adjustment, electrical power, peak RAM or temperature. One Pi timing is not a stable benchmark. Private capture and point cloud are not committed.
